record.t: Was elected president of the Conference of Chief Justices and board chair of the National Center for State Courts for a one-year term in 2025.
record.q: In 2025 for a one year term, Chief Justice Seitz was elected President of the Conference of Chief Justices and board chair of the National Center for State Courts.

record.t: Was sworn in as chief justice of the Delaware Supreme Court on Nov. 8, 2019.
record.q: Seitz, Jr. was sworn in as Chief Justice of the Supreme Court of Delaware on November 8, 2019.

record.t: Was a founding partner of Seitz Ross Aronstam & Moritz LLP before his appointment.
record.q: Prior to his appointment, Chief Justice Seitz was a founding partner of Seitz Ross Aronstam & Moritz LLP.

record.t: Chaired the Delaware Board of Bar Examiners and served on the Board on Professional Responsibility.
record.q: A member of the Delaware Bar since 1983, Chief Justice Seitz formerly served as a board member and chair of the Delaware Board of Bar Examiners, and a board member of the Board on Professional Responsibility.

record.t: Was often appointed by federal and state courts as a master and trustee in complex corporate, commercial and intellectual property cases.
record.q: Both federal and state courts often appointed Chief Justice Seitz as a Master and Trustee to oversee complex corporate, commercial and intellectual property cases.
